# Native IDEAL component unit controls

Exact Sonnet 18.53 Lite manufactured-coupon sources, raw R50 responses,
engine stdout/stderr, source-selection guards, native response logs and
run metadata. No source or output was rewritten while promoting these files.

Three RES controls prove OH16.77 == KOH.01677 and distinguish KOH16.77.
Six independent CAP/IND controls prove PF1 == NF.001 and NH1 == UH.001;
the same literals in NF/UH produce distinct physical responses.

The source geometry uses matched actual32x40 cells. The public DiffMoM
comparison retains its physical cover-return leads and uses the prior
0.03 full-complex-S raw fixture gate. Equivalent physical unit controls
use the unchanged1e-10 numerical gate and exact native equality.
These files do not establish coupled pin-group calibration equivalence.

Before/after RES failure logs are retained. SHA256 entries cover all
promoted raw files and this README; the manifest does not hash itself.
